reader_summary.headline: Is it “white", "heavy-set" men "playing golf" and making arrangements in "smoke-filled back rooms”?
reader_summary.overview: Is it “white", "heavy-set" men "playing golf" and making arrangements in "smoke-filled back rooms”? It's not like that anymore. Given the tech industry’s increasing engagement with policy, how does lobbying play out for tech companies in particular? What are the challenges when going up against deeply entrenched incumbents, as all startups inevitably do?

key_points.text: And finally, how has tech itself changed the act of lobbying?
Thanks in part to the internet, we're now in a new era of transparency and public engagement.
